Pain Au Chocolat, Vella Longa and Barwon Heights have the benefit of race experience.

raceTips.comment:
Staphani was a big drifter ($5-$17) in the betting at her Australian debut having won a weak form race on debut and following what looked an underwhelming jumpout. She should strip fitter for that run and looks a strong winning chance from a more favourable barrier. 
Annotate looks ready to win third following two promising runs this preparation. 
Crossoverkid will eventually win one of these. He was typically good first up and looks even better suited here. His record of 1-17, many of which have been in easier races, is the concern.
